_about: Atmosphere layers — the first interactive diagram (Bengali). Written by the editor (Claude) on 2026-09-27 from the draft বায়ুমণ্ডল_খসড়া.xlsx at the user's request to start the atmosphere work, before the user's book corrections. User decision 2026-09-27: take NOAA's figures where sources differ or a value was pending; the user will update the information later. Every record carries a review note. Main source: NOAA JetStream 'Layers of the Atmosphere'. Bengali layer and boundary names from Bengali Wikipedia (revision 8560010) until the user's textbook confirms them. Heights above the troposphere are drawn not to scale. No API calls: this file is the diagram's only data input.
